'''Fannis Gult''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] and a veteran member of the [[Guild Enforcers]]. She once led an investigation into a series of [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] attacks on [[Figg Excavations/Legends|FiggEx]] [[Transport/Legends|transports]] in the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] sector. After hiring some local help to aid in the investigation, she began to suspect FiggEx as well as its [[FiggEx Security|security force]] were involved somehow.<ref name="Rough and Tundra" />
